after.lineEndings: bundleSHA256 identifies the local tested/packaged bytes. deployedBundleSHA256 identifies the same source after Git normalizes CRLF to LF. No other source differences.

notes: Sequential captures on this machine; each final table entry is one measured run, not a confidence interval.
Scenes pin altitude or position for repeatability; water/slime dynamics and scheduling can still vary.
Headless RAF intervals measure callbacks. Visible PresentMon display intervals are recorded separately.
Main-thread bucket times include API submission and stalls; they are not hardware GPU timings.
GPU-process trace spans are wall time and may contain waits. Parent and child events are not added together.
Fixed-altitude nightflight reaches a pillar and includes contact, with horizontal movement during about 28 to 29 percent of frames. Drive is the uninterrupted horizontal motion fixture.
